import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a,b,c,d,f,g,h,k,m,p = params[:10]
    num = a + b/T + (c + d*np.sqrt(T) + m/T)*eps
    den = (1 + (k + f/T)*eps + h*eps**2)
    return -eps*num*np.exp(-(g + p/T)*eps)/den
